name: Thia-Cal Liquid B1 Supplement for Horses by Finish Line Horse, Gallon (64 - 128 days)
description: A palatable liquid formula that contains 500 mg/oz. of pure thiamine (B1) along with calcium, magnesium, potassium, and chloride. Calcium and magnesium interact with the thiamine to enhance the effectiveness of the B vitamin. Chloride was added to provide an acid/base balance, and potassium helps protect against muscle weakness, nervousness and irritability. Use Thia-Cal for horses subject to stress or for horses with nervous dispositions. | Thia-Cal Liquid B1 Supplement for Horses by Finish Line Horse, Gallon (64 - 128 days)
